instruction: Open a rented Disney+ movie in VLC and verify that all included bonus features and extras are available.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Disney+ content is protected by Widevine DRM and can only be streamed through authorized browsers or the Disney+ native application. VLC has no capability to authenticate with Disney+ services or decrypt their DRM-protected streams.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: Widevine DRM and platform restrictions - Disney+ requires authorized playback environment
